decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records that the requested document must contain the blog topic as well as keywords; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Requesting a document containing the blog topic and keywords does not change internal-link requirements.
The document request does not change publication approval or publication prerequisites.
The source does not change blog image coverage, relevance, count, or publication conditions.
The requested topic-and-keyword document does not alter the target audience for the AI dolls blog.
The source requests a separate topic-and-keyword document and does not change the number or type of blog articles to be delivered.

The source specifically requests a document containing a blog topic and its keywords; it does not change the separate keyword research report's count, search-volume requirement, or replacement keywords.
The topic-and-keyword document request does not alter the scope or contents of the separate SEO plan deliverable.
